source.name: Anthropic Economic Index
source.method: every task of the career's O*NET occupations matching the skill (reviewed, none ranked by penetration); per task penetration x share of automation (directive, feedback_loop) or augmentation (task_iteration, validation, learning) interactions; per skill the mean over its tasks, then over the careers that need it
source.limits: Usage of Claude on US O*NET tasks: a signal of where AI enters work, not jobs lost and not Malaysian data.
